content: Eurostat: EU unadjusted gender pay gap 11.1% for reference year 2024 (euro area 11.4%), range -0.8% Luxembourg to 18.8% Estonia. Defined as difference in average gross HOURLY earnings expressed as a percentage of male average. Eurostat states it is broader than discrimination and reflects both differences in average characteristics and differences in returns to the same characteristics. Coverage: enterprises with 10+ employees, NACE Rev.2 B to S excluding O (public administration and defence). Source is the four-yearly Structure of Earnings Survey; intermediate years are national estimates; 2024 figures are provisional until December 2026 benchmark.
